CheckTitle: Check if there is any unassigned Elastic IP
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks for Elastic IP addresses that are not associated with any instance or network interface.
Risk: Orphaned public IPs incur cost, clutter inventory and can be re-associated to unintended resources.

Recommendation.Text: Release Elastic IPs that are not in use.

Notes: Not a numbered CIS AWS 3.0 control; mapped to 5.2 (network exposure). Also a cost finding.
